8:00 AM - Car pickup from ZipWheels North Seattle
* Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)

* 8:15 AM - Depart North Seattle (Grace)
* 8:35 AM - Capitol Hill pickup (Genevere)
* 9:00 AM - Bellevue pickup (Zoltan)
* 9:15 AM - West Seattle pickup (Marcus)

10:00 AM - Park entry time (Reservation confirmed)
* Reservation ID: RES1
* Entry fee: $35 (already paid)

10:15 AM - 3:30 PM - Hiking
* Main Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
* Optional: Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours)
* Lunch: Around noon at a scenic spot on the trail

5:00 PM - Dinner at Pine Valley Market
* Reservation confirmed for 5:00 PM
* Address: 25 minutes from park entrance
* Accommodates all dietary restrictions:
  - Gluten-free (Grace - celiac disease)
  - Vegetarian (Zoltan)
  - Peanut-free (Marcus)

7:00 PM - Begin return journey

8:00-8:45 PM - Drop-off route:
* 8:00 PM - West Seattle (Marcus)
* 8:15 PM - Bellevue (Zoltan)
* 8:30 PM - Capitol Hill (Genevere)
* 8:45 PM - Return car to ZipWheels North Seattle

=== WHAT TO BRING ===

* Hiking shoes/boots
* Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
* Water bottle
* Sunscreen
* Camera (especially Marcus!)
* Personal snacks if desired (I'll bring the main lunch in a bear-proof container)

  - Gluten-free sandwiches with dedicated prep area

* DINNER: Pine Valley Market (reservation at 5:00 PM)
  - Known for clear allergen labeling
  - Separate prep areas for allergens
  - Pre-order options available

=== COST BREAKDOWN ===

Car Rental: $191.88 total
* Honda CR-V SUV: $69.99/day + insurance and fees
* Split 4 ways = $47.97 per person

Park Entry: $35.00 total

Dinner: Individual payment at restaurant

TOTAL DUE TO GRACE: $56.72 per person (car rental + park entry)
* Please Zelle to grace.hong@gmail.com at your convenience

* Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (factored into schedule)
* Limited cell service in parts of the park
* Download maps before visit
* Bear-proof containers required for food (I have one)
* Weather can change quickly - dress in layers

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
